description: This Java source file defines an Android activity class 'ScreenSlideActivity' that demonstrates a screen-slide animation using ViewPager, managing multiple pages in a wizard-like interface with navigation controls.

classes.name: ScreenSlideActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating a screen-slide animation with multiple pages and navigation controls.

classes.name: ScreenSlidePagerAdapter
classes.description: A nested class extending FragmentStatePagerAdapter to supply page fragments for the ViewPager.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ViewPager and its adapter, and defines page change behavior.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and dynamically adds a 'next' or 'finish' action based on current page.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles navigation actions like 'up', 'previous', and 'next' in the wizard.
